releases.title: Studio 2.1: an owner status line and small fixes
items: New: a short status line near the top, where the owner shares how Studio is doing, what comes next, and when it was last updated.
Search and tag filters now also show in Others, and in any list with two or more entries.
On a phone held sideways, the start of Products now shows without scrolling.
Links to a section now stay on target even when fonts or images load late.
Behind the scenes: publishing the reading list is checked as strictly as the site checks, and a failing main branch now raises an alarm by email.

releases.title: Studio 2.0: a simpler, safer and easier-to-use Studio
items: A full overhaul: one clear order (Products, Updates, Reads, Podcasts) and the same menu on every screen, on phone and desktop.
Reads has Technical and Others sections with search and tags, and a link can open either one directly. Books sit under the reads.
The Blog is now Podcasts: shows and episodes worth a listen, each with sharing. Old Blog links still work.
Easier on a phone and for everyone: bigger tap targets, clear focus, readable contrast, a tighter first screen, and it works at high zoom.
Safer by design: stricter checks on every link and file, bounded waits, no cookies, no tracking, and nothing about your visit is recorded.
Behind the scenes: every change is tested in a real browser, and the security-sensitive ones get an independent review.

releases.title: Reads now split into Technical and Others
items: Reads has two tabs, Technical and Others, so you can go straight to the kind of reading you want.
A link ending in #reads/technical or #reads/others opens that tab directly.
Search and tag filters work inside the tab you are on; each tab shows how many items it holds.
Books are sorted into the same two tabs.
Behind the scenes: the automatic checks that guard the site are stricter and were reviewed independently.

releases.title: More dependable product updates
items: If one product fails to update, you are now told, and its last good details stay on the page.
Hidden or malformed links in published content are now refused before they go live.
A daily check now also confirms the nightly update has really been running.
A new runbook explains how to fix every problem the checks can raise.

releases.title: Logo, profile photo and a more private page
items: Studio has its own logo, shown in the header and the browser tab.
A profile photo can now appear at the top of the page.
Fonts now load from Studio itself, so no third party sees your visit.
The header now fits at every window width; it overflowed slightly between phone and tablet sizes.
More safeguards behind the scenes: a protected main branch, pinned automation and a keep-alive for the nightly updates.

releases.title: Safer sign-in and What's new
items: See what changed with the new What's new button.
The version now shows at the bottom of every page.
Admin sign-in is forgotten when the tab closes.
Tighter security rules for page styling.

releases.title: Reliability
items: Automatic checks on every change and every day to catch problems early.
Dates show the right day in every timezone.
Download buttons can point at the right file (Penny now downloads the app, not a document).

releases.title: Reads and a refreshed look
items: Share a read: a searchable reading list with tag filters, Share on LinkedIn and Copy link.
Studio by Debasis Ray, learning never ends!
Easier to use: keyboard friendly, clearer colours, larger touch targets, light and dark themes.
Phone fix: long release notes no longer push the page sideways and are collapsed.
